contract: Turn changes default expanded. Native button/aria and Enter/Space toggle only the existing body. Counts and whole-turn undo/status remain visible; per-file nodes and pending undo state are retained. Explicit choices are bounded128 per domain/session/turn, with no persistent global setting.

Main/subagent capture one immutable execution snapshot immediately after the actual request model resolves. Three main tool call sites and the subagent tool site carry the same snapshot. Steward dedicated prompt includes the shared identity once.

execution identifies a host-selected request route/model and native-provider wire protocol, not a verified proxy backend. Missing host context and unproven CLI remain unknown. The identity-only section returns before reading configuration.

config contains consistent global defaults, including its own modalities/protocol. capabilities describes the actual runtime provider when supplied and names its own provider/source. Historical usage and configuration tools declare provenance and cannot override execution identity.

Protocol display labels live in existing backend/frontend registries, with bilingual label equality checks. Current engine label, chip/title/menu follow the selected protocol. Capability popovers use explicit recognized protocol from their own cached packet; old/unknown packets stay generic.

Historical message badges and usage records are not relabeled from the current configuration. Stored route values, model-selection priority, permission/undo behavior, billing keys and capability-cache lifetime are unchanged.

Normal interaction adds no dialog, password, setting or deployment dependency. New execution/prompt labels omit URL-shaped credentials/query material; this is not a claim that legacy configuration labels or all tool payloads are globally sanitized.
